```{r}
source("DLLCensusSource.R")
source("pir_source.R")

library(patchwork)
library(tidycensus)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(leaflet)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(htmltools)

options(tidyverse.quiet = TRUE)

hs_palette <- c("#e51937","#0063a6","#fff13b","#499f68","#84dcc6","#693668","#373d20","#717744")
```

## Dual Language Learners in MA, 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of infants and children 0-5 that are DLL in MA"

statewide_dll <- statewide_dll

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = round(statewide_dll, 0)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of the infants and children 0-5 that are DLL in MA"

statewide_percentage <- statewide_percent * 100

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(statewide_percentage, 2)
)
```

## Head Start Dual Language Learners, MA, 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of DLL children that Head Start serves in MA"

dll_hs <- headstart_dll_ma|>
  filter(pir_year == 2024)
headstart_dll <- dll_hs$total_dll_enroll

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = headstart_dll
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are DLL in MA"

headstart_total <- dll_hs$total_child_enroll

hsdllprop <- headstart_dll/headstart_total
hsdllpercentage <- hsdllprop * 100

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(hsdllpercentage, 2)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Percent of dual language learners in MA that Head Start serves"

hsswdllprop <- headstart_dll/statewide_dll
hsswdllpercentage <- hsswdllprop * 100

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(hsswdllpercentage, 2)
)
```

## Temporal Visualizations

```{r}
#| fill: false

options(scipen = 999)
overall_data |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(Location == "MASSACHUSETTS" ~ "MASSACHUSETTS",
                           Location != "MASSACHUSETTS" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(TimeFrame, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(dll_children = sum(proxy_dll_under5, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_population = sum(total_children, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(TimeFrame) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MASSACHUSETTS" ~ "MASSACHUSETTS",
                           is_ma != "MASSACHUSETTS" ~ "USA"),
         dll_children = case_when(is_ma == "MASSACHUSETTS" ~ dll_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(dll_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_population = case_when(is_ma == "MASSACHUSETTS" ~ total_population,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_population)),
         ,
      percent_dll1 = dll_children / total_population * 100)

  ggplot(aes(x = TimeFrame, y = percent_dll1, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "% DLL Children",
       col = "",
       title = paste("DLL Population via 5-17 Proxy, ")) +
  theme_minimal()  +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_dll1, 2)), 
            vjust = -0.25)
```

## Rankings

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "How Massachusetts ranks compared to other states in terms of percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are dual language learners"
#| fill: false

dll_state_rank <- combined_pir |>
  group_by(pir_year, State) |>
  summarize(total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE), 
            total_dll_enroll = sum(A.27, na.rm = TRUE),
            percent_dll = total_dll_enroll / total_child_enroll * 100, 2) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(state_rank = rank(-percent_dll, ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup()

ma_ranking <- dll_state_rank |>
  filter(State == "MA" & pir_year == 2024) |>
  select(state_rank) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "award",
  color = "info",
  value = ma_ranking
)
```

```{r}
#| fill: false
#| title: "Top 5 States + MA in terms of percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are dual language learners"
dll_state_rank |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024 & (State == "MA" | state_rank <= 5)) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_dll)) |>
  select(State, 
         `% dual language learners` = percent_dll ) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| fill: false

us_states <- states(cb = TRUE, 
                    resolution = "20m", 
                    progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  left_join(dll_state_rank |>
              filter(pir_year == 2024), by = c("STUSPS" = "State")) |>
  st_transform(4326)

labels <- paste("<strong>", 
                us_states$NAME,
                "</strong><br>Rank:", 
                us_states$state_rank,
                "<br>% dual language learners:",
                us_states$percent_dll) |>
  lapply(htmltools::HTML)

pal_bin_state_rank <- colorBin(palette="BuGn", 
                    domain = us_states$percent_dll,
                    bins = 4)

dll_hs_map <- leaflet(width = "100%") %>%
  setView(lat = 30, lng = -95, zoom = 3) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap) |> 
  addPolygons(data = us_states, 
              weight = 1,
              color = "black",
              fillColor = ~pal_bin_state_rank(percent_dll),
              fillOpacity = 0.8, 
              label = labels) |>
  addLegend(data = us_states,
            title = "% Dual Language Learners", 
            pal = pal_bin_state_rank, 
            values = ~percent_dll)

dll_hs_map
```
